verdict.rationale: Sprinto's API reference has a dedicated "Custom Integration Push APIs" section (an Integration Monitoring page) alongside Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs. Its ingestion webhooks give each webhook a unique endpoint URL that external systems can send data to, triggering ingestion workflows with activity review and troubleshooting. However, the evidence shows only page titles for the push APIs, says nothing about pushing evidence or test results specifically, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation of the push APIs (payload schemas, auth), explicit confirmation that pushed data maps to evidence or control test results, a machine-readable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
